scope: Independent review of the frozen Android and shared mobile feature candidates; no candidate deployment or real business dispatch

findings.title: Unresolved historical assignees expose private task notifications
findings.reproduction: Create a private employee and an unexecuted task assigned by employee ID or name. Ordinary repository deletion removes the employee row. A different member's notification list changes from zero to two visible items; resolving each item succeeds. Renaming private employee A to B separately exposes the unexecuted task whose assignee remains A.
findings.required: Fail closed when the historical assignee's current visibility cannot be proved. Cover real repository deletion and rename, not only status=deleted. Preserve demonstrably valid unassigned and human-member tasks.

findings.title: Omitting the mobile view bypasses group-member visibility on the new exact-action route
findings.reproduction: For the same member and action, use a visible source employee and a room containing another owner's private employee. GET /api/workspaces/:slug/actions/:id returns 200 and the private group-log marker; adding ?view=mobile returns 404 GROUP_MOBILE_SCOPE_REQUIRED.
findings.required: The new route must apply the same group visibility authorization for every response format. The view query must not control authorization.

findings.title: A visible employee ID can mask an unbound native logical profile
findings.reproduction: Keep a visible member_id but replace the room member or target logical profile with unbound-private-native-profile. The mobile projection still succeeds.
findings.required: Validate the Ziwei group logical-profile/member-ID mapping and target kind/profile contract. Do not compare the logical profile with the employee's physical runtime_profile.

findings.title: Starting a new group clears the old-host upgrade gate
findings.reproduction: Receive an unpaged old-host read, observe upgrade_required, return to the group list, start a new group, select a target and send. The in-memory controller produces one collaborateBot POST.
findings.required: Retain the capability failure in a gate scoped to source/device/profile/revision. Starting another group must not clear it; clear only after fresh successful paged verification or a newly verified source.

findings.title: Private assignment proof is exposed by public audit, notification and realtime reads
findings.reproduction: With a real ordinary-member cookie in an isolated memory app, a private employee is absent from the employee list and its detail returns 404. An unexecuted task refers only to its unique name alias. Public audit, legacy notification raw payload_json and parsed payload, and member SSE task.created/task.updated events nevertheless disclose the new typed employee entityId and taskId association.
findings.required: Keep authoritative assignmentBinding in the audit database for internal reminder validation. Strip the new private field from public audit and notification projections, both raw and parsed fields, archive responses and onEvent payloads delivered through SSE/WebSocket. Preserve original task IDs, notification counts and unrelated fields; do not replace the assignment authorization repair or redesign all audit permissions.

rootVerification.combination: git merge-tree of fixed main and shared candidate completed without conflict; temporary archive only, not merged into the release branch
rootVerification.excludedHypothesis: Old clients do not call the native JS normalizer on this execution path. They pass pagination fields to the older Python bridge, which returns a full log. The proposed old-field-normalization-to-quarantine failure was excluded by fixed-source probes.
rootVerification.limits: Passing existing tests does not resolve the reproduced findings. No production writes, model execution, real group dispatch, mobile feature deployment or public APK publication were performed.

handoff.action: All four findings and the rename boundary were returned to the candidate owner for fixes and new regression evidence before another release review.
handoff.primaryIncident: Zhiwei's historical action remains unresolved pending the original Windows host diagnostic; this mobile review does not provide its missing receipt.

groupEvidence.privateTarget: All six view variants return 404 without history
groupEvidence.identity: Eight logical identity mutations rejected; a legitimate different physical runtime profile remains accepted

notificationEvidence.remainingReproduction: A private employee initially named as an existing member ID, user ID, or another visible employee ID loses the current-name veto after rename. All three old unexecuted task notifications then become visible and resolve successfully, even after the renamed employee is deleted.

rechecks.requiredFollowUp: The candidate owner may add server-generated assignment bindings to existing task creation/assignment audit writes without a schema change. Reads and unrelated full-DTO saves must not manufacture historical bindings; unresolved assignments must invalidate earlier proof. Existing nonempty historical assignments without trustworthy binding remain hidden from the new reminder feed.
rechecks.reportedAndroidNativeLimit: The exact ab5045a APK installed with version/assets/firstInstallTime preserved, but baseline code9 and the new APK both encounter TLS connection closure in the private emulator. Chat/draft/group entry acceptance for that exact APK is unproven; earlier candidate success must not be substituted. The Android owner reports no network/TLS changes and cleaned up the private clone.

rechecks.assignmentRecheck: Fixed-source independent memory checks close original deletion, rename and all three canonical-ID-style alias rename/delete cases. New typed assignments work, historical nonempty assignments and same-value DTOs do not mint proof, latest invalid markers cannot reuse old proof, and later names cannot reinterpret typed identity.
rechecks.writerReview: Server derives proof from actual persisted assignee values at the two official repository write boundaries. No public audit write entry point was found; client proof fields are ignored. The narrow savepoint buffers events until commit. This does not imply public reads of the new proof are safe.
rechecks.unchangedBaselineRepositoryFailures: The candidate owner reproduced the same three runtime/model/profile discovery failures in its prior d6fbfbb archive. This recheck did not label the entire repository suite green.
rechecks.nextStep: The candidate owner is fixing only the newly exposed private proof at public read/event boundaries, retaining the closed assignment authorization logic and the already-reviewed Android and group changes.
